# Goal
Round 41 for lane kama (local model serving and endpoint health): verify and falsify the frozen claims and support the frontier step. C1 calibration 7→7 — the SCORECARD.md head `## Axes` table now matches observed repository state (counter tools/round41-scorecard-reconcile.py; base mismatches=16 met=False). C2 operability 8→8, capability acquisition `pin-watch` — tools/pin-watch.py reports newer upstream releases for the lane's pinned engines (counter tools/round41-pinwatch-audit.py; base all legs 0). Integration owner is the L1 (KamaR41). You produce findings and drafts only; you never edit lane or fleet files.
# Evidence under test (read only)
- Lane clone /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone — a fresh clone of the lane remote https://github.com/VeigaPunk/kama-shokunin.git. Base 8893b89466250c4d542912a867392698d2da00ce; freeze 6fec0c4cd7b63ac733f2ae47fe73d1366b40c6dd (counters, preregistration, controls); claim commit and tip 24aa1d3485c107f88b8b838892d43ea7587befcf. Never write inside /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone; to run anything that writes, make your own clone: `git clone -q /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone /tmp/<your-name>-clone`.
- Frozen contract: /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/.ufo/waves/round-41/preregistration.json; controls /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/.ufo/waves/round-41/controls/; candidate receipts /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/.ufo/waves/round-41/c1/candidate.out and /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/.ufo/waves/round-41/c2/candidate.out; tag evidence /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/.ufo/waves/round-41/c2/.
- Prior closure with routed defects: /fast/scratch/kama-r41/clone/corpus/lessons/round-40-verifier-spotcheck.md.
# Output
- Your tools start at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write your report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path> (the parked lane worktree; the only lane path seats may write). Put any extra artifacts in a directory named after you beside that report. Lead the report with a one-line verdict, then evidence: commands, outputs, exit codes, file:line.
# Constraints
- /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (source repo), sibling lanes and the fleet repo are READ-ONLY. Never write, commit, fetch or push there; never run campaign tools (renumber-staged.py, merge-plan.py, quote-lint.py, absent-defect-register.py); never edit MISSION.md, AXES.md, scripts/, templates/, .ufo/state/, .scratch/ or considerthese/.
- Never mutate the lane's jj state or Git index (parked worktree or clone); read-only git is fine. Any fixture repo: D=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$D" init -q; every later git/jj call names -C "$D"; verify `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals $D before the first commit. Never run git commit or jj with a throwaway identity anywhere else.
- Tooling: you may install or upgrade tools that help the task — read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first (official channels, update-safety gate; record tool/version/channel/reason in your report). pacman guard: ALL pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide — never run pacman; install via uv tool / npx / an official binary in ~/.local/bin, or report the need.
- Never start, stop or restart services; never message agent://all; do not spawn subagents (leaf). Never invent evidence: an unrun check has not passed.
